person_roles.applicant: Person who has submitted an admission application.
person_roles.student: Admitted/enrolled learner with an institutional student record.

academic.course: A credit-bearing academic offering identified by a course code.
academic.result: An academic outcome; distinguish draft and official result.
academic.grade: The grade assigned to a validated score according to the configured grading scale.
academic.score: Numeric assessment mark before grade conversion.

admissions.admission_decision: The authoritative institutional decision on an application.

finance.payment: A transaction record/attempt against an invoice or obligation.
finance.receipt: Evidence generated from an authoritative successful transaction.

rules: Do not use labels interchangeably when they represent different business states.
Student-facing screens must distinguish Official/Published results from drafts.
Draft must never be presented as an official result.
Actions must use verbs that describe the actual business operation.
